# Narrative Small Moment Stretch Page

Subject: Writing
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Drafting Page
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A primary writing page that helps students stretch one small moment with feelings, action, and talk.

## Alignment Note
Supports narrative sequencing, details, and age-appropriate writing craft.

## Classroom Use Case
Use after oral storytelling to help students expand one scene instead of listing events.

## Preview Content
- What happened?
- What did someone say?
- How did you feel?

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
